words.definition: a special event when people celebrate something together
words.example: The city has a big music festival every summer.

words.definition: a special time when people enjoy themselves for a happy reason
words.example: There was a big celebration for the new year.

words.definition: a public event where people walk together, often with music
words.example: We watched a colorful parade in the street.

words.definition: a small object that explodes with bright lights in the sky
words.example: The fireworks lit up the night sky.

words.definition: something used to make a place look nice for a special event
words.example: We put up decorations for the festival.

words.definition: a light in a container that you can carry or hang
words.example: People hung colorful lanterns in the street.

words.definition: something you give to someone, often for a special day
words.example: We exchange gifts during the holiday.

words.definition: a large, special meal for many people
words.example: The family shared a big feast together.

words.definition: a special day when people do not work and often celebrate
words.example: Next week is a national holiday in my country.

words.definition: to ask someone to come to an event
words.example: She invited all her friends to the festival.

words.definition: a person who is invited to an event
words.example: We had many guests at our celebration.

words.definition: a stick of wax with a string that you burn for light
words.example: They lit candles for the festival.

words.definition: something you wear to cover your face
words.example: Children wore colorful masks in the parade.

words.definition: a musical instrument you hit to make sound
words.example: Musicians played the drum during the parade.

words.definition: a large group of people gathered together
words.example: A big crowd watched the fireworks.

words.definition: something that happens, especially something planned
words.example: The festival is the biggest event of the year.

words.definition: to go to an event
words.example: Thousands of people attend the festival every year.

words.definition: having many bright colors
words.example: The costumes at the festival were very colorful.

words.definition: a feeling of great happiness
words.example: Festivals bring joy to families and friends.

words.definition: to come together in one place
words.example: People gather in the square to celebrate.

text: Festivals happen in every country around the world, and each one is special. During a festival, people often gather in the streets to watch a parade with music, dancing, and colorful costumes. Some festivals also have fireworks that light up the sky at night, and everyone in the crowd looks up with joy. Before a big festival, families often put up decorations at home, like lights or paper lanterns. Sometimes people light candles too. Many festivals are also national holidays, so people do not have to work and can spend the whole day celebrating with family. Guests are often invited to a big feast, where everyone eats together and shares gifts. In some countries, people wear masks and dance to the sound of drums during the festival. Every year, thousands of tourists attend famous festivals just to see the amazing parades and decorations. Even though festivals are different in every country, they all bring people together and create a feeling of joy and community. Festivals help us remember our culture and enjoy time with the people we love.
